_note: Nat_multitask_efficientnetv2_l_v3_uncalibrated: Multi-task EfficientNetV2-L baseline optimized specifically for uncalibrated (gamma=0) generalized zero-shot evaluation. Pretrained on ImageNet-21k and fine-tuned on ImageNet-1k (tf_efficientnetv2_l.in21k_ft_in1k via timm). Gamma tuning is disabled ('gamma_grid': 0) so Stage 1 validation and early stopping target uncalibrated Harmonic Mean directly. Disease head is given higher loss weight (crop 0.7 / disease 1.3) to counter seen-disease dominance and prioritize pathology feature learning across the 175 disease classes. Incorporates symptom-preserving crop scale [0.5, 1.0], 1-epoch backbone warm-up, and 3-split cross-validation.

data._note: Evaluation on test_seen (2,000) and test_unseen (1,448) across all 333 composition pairs.

model._note: EfficientNetV2-L pretrained backbone (IN-21k) with dual linear heads (crop 55, disease 175) and dropout 0.2.

input._note: Standard 256x256 cache with 224x224 center crop for evaluation.

augmentation._note: Symptom-preserving crop scale [0.5, 1.0] avoids cropping out isolated lesions, with horizontal and vertical flips and gentle color jitter.

loss._note: Rebalanced task weights: disease head weighted 1.3 vs crop 0.7 to counter the severe imbalance between easy crop recognition (55 classes, >90% top-1) and hard disease diagnosis (175 classes, ~8% unseen top-1). Label smoothing 0.1 prevents overconfident logit extremes.

scheduler._note: Cosine annealing scheduler with 2 warmup epochs decaying to min_lr_ratio 0.01.
scheduler.name: cosine

validation._note: gamma_grid: 0 disables gamma tuning. Stage 1 validation and early stopping evaluate solely at gamma=0.0 to pick the optimal epoch for pure uncalibrated performance across 3 validation splits.

training._note: freeze_backbone_epochs: 1 warms up dual heads. Early stopping with patience 8 monitoring uncalibrated val HM. Refit schedule 'compress' matches schedule to best_epoch.

evaluation._note: Standard DPD benchmark metrics: Top-1, Top-5, per-class means, and Harmonic Mean (HM).

runtime._note: AMP mixed precision on CUDA with 4 workers. Checkpointing every 5 epochs.
